meta.nature_of_results: simulation / analytical model — not measurements on physical AURORA-Q hardware

conditional.label: Conditional reset (measure + flip, ≈ 4 µs incl. latency) — assumption

dissipative.label: Dedicated dissipative reset (≈1 µs idle between circuits, IBM-reported)

aurora_pipelined.label: AURORA: reset overlapped with result readout/next-circuit load

validation.nighthawk_r2_reported: >100,000 (IBM; protocol/circuit size not published in the sources we could access)

throughput.insight: Throughput gain is (t_rep + t_c + t_m)/(t_idle + t_c + t_m): ≈25x+ for few-µs circuits, but it falls toward ≈5x for 50 µs circuits. Deep circuits gain mostly through the lower initialisation error, not speed.

physics.note: Illustrative Lindblad model of a dissipative reset element; not a model of IBM's proprietary circuit.

ancilla_reuse.description: Fraction of shots with ≥1 spurious syndrome flip when no data error is injected beyond 0.1 % CX depolarisation; reset errors propagate directly into false syndrome events.
